3:10.text: Verily, those who disbelieve, neither their properties nor their offspring will avail them whatsoever against Allâh; and it is they who will be fuel of the Fire.

3:11.text: Like the behaviour of the people of Fir‘aun
and those before them; they belied Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
them for their sins. And Allâh is Severe in punishment.

3:12.text: to those who disbelieve: "You will be defeated and gathered together to Hell, and worst indeed is that place to rest."

3:13.text: There has already been a sign for you
in the two armies that met
(in combat i.e. the battle of Badr)
. One was fighting in the Cause of Allâh, and as for the other,
with their own eyes twice their number
. And Allâh supports with His Victory whom He wills. Verily, in this is a lesson for those who understand.

3:14.text: Beautified for men is the love of things they covet; women, children, much of gold and silver
, branded beautiful horses, cattle and well-tilled land. This is the pleasure of the present world’s life; but Allâh has the excellent return
